# UC-PAM-SCRIPT — Privilege Demo — Request Access Script

**Track:** learn  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  


## Buyer Story

An end user requests JIT access to AWS AppRoles, fine-grained S3 buckets, VPC bundles, and optional Kubernetes — approved through four-eyes workflows.

## PingOne Solution

PingOne Privilege brokers federated AWS access, gateway tunnels to VPC resources, sudo command filtering, session recording, and policy kill switches.
